purpose: Style-specific, consent-safe subject matrices for ArtStyle cross-model portability audits

styles.selection_rationale: Print-room, street-life, portable-electronics, and dense-city subjects expose ink separation and registration behavior while spanning people, motion, hard products, and layered depth.

cases.subject: night-shift newspaper printer wearing an ink apron
cases.composition: waist-up three-quarter portrait beside a stack of blank paper

cases.subject: urban pigeon lifting into flight
cases.composition: single bird crossing the frame diagonally with wings fully spread

cases.subject: portable cassette player, headphones, and two tape cases
cases.composition: overhead product arrangement with clear gaps between objects

cases.subject: dense hillside neighborhood with stairways and rooftop water tanks
cases.composition: wide layered cityscape rising from lower left to upper right

styles.selection_rationale: Field observation, translucency, glass, and tidal terrain suit cyanotype's contact-print logic while testing whether it can resolve a person, a soft animal, reflective objects, and deep space.

cases.subject: coastal field researcher holding an empty specimen tray
cases.composition: standing three-quarter portrait with windblown coat and open space to one side

cases.subject: moon jellyfish drifting with four trailing tentacles
cases.composition: single translucent animal suspended off-center in open water

cases.subject: glass bottles, brass dividers, and folded cotton cloth
cases.composition: shallow tabletop arrangement with overlapping silhouettes

cases.subject: rocky tidal cove at low tide beneath an open sky
cases.composition: wide view with exposed pools leading toward a distant headland

styles.selection_rationale: Carried baskets, crossing grasses, overlapping tabletop silhouettes, and a curving street create natural layer boundaries without asking the source generator for collage styling.

cases.subject: street-food vendor carrying a shallow basket
cases.composition: frontal half-length portrait with basket cutting across the lower frame

cases.subject: red fox stepping through tall grass
cases.composition: full animal in profile with grasses crossing its legs

cases.subject: ceramic kettle, three lemons, and a striped dish towel
cases.composition: casual tabletop still life with one lemon separated in front

cases.subject: tram curving through a steep neighborhood
cases.composition: street-level view with tracks sweeping from foreground into clustered buildings

styles.selection_rationale: Angular human balance and rigid products are sympathetic tests; radial agave growth and a sparse salt-flat horizon are stress tests for preserving decisive geometry across organic and open scenes.

cases.subject: contemporary dancer in structured rehearsal clothes holding an angular balance pose
cases.composition: full-length studio portrait with the figure reaching across a tall off-center frame

cases.subject: agave rosette with a small beetle on one blade
cases.composition: low close view with pointed leaves radiating beyond the frame

cases.subject: folding chair, adjustable desk lamp, and rectangular book
cases.composition: three objects meeting as a compact asymmetric product group

cases.subject: salt flat with a distant mesa and one utility tower
cases.composition: very wide horizon with the tower isolated in the right third

styles.selection_rationale: Radio equipment and a pre-sunrise platform exercise the style's technical-dawn vocabulary, while a human face and turning koi test whether cel reconstruction works on skin, hair, and organic motion without a reference image.

cases.subject: overnight radio operator wearing headphones
cases.composition: off-center shoulders-up portrait with a console edge in the foreground

cases.subject: two koi turning in opposite directions beneath rippled water
cases.composition: overhead circular movement with open water at the center

cases.subject: portable field radio, coiled cable, and signal meter
cases.composition: low three-quarter product view with the cable crossing the foreground

cases.subject: elevated railway platform just before sunrise
cases.composition: long one-point perspective with tracks exiting toward the horizon

styles.selection_rationale: A stretched athlete and segmented animal test living anatomy; a rigid espresso machine and repeated turbine landscape deliberately test whether soft volumetric treatment transfers beyond naturally rounded subjects.

cases.subject: youth goalkeeper in padded kit holding a ball overhead
cases.composition: full-length environmental portrait in front of a goal net with the body stretched diagonally

cases.subject: armadillo walking with its segmented shell visible
cases.composition: ground-level side view with the full animal and a long cast shadow

cases.subject: compact espresso machine, cup, and tamper
cases.composition: straight-on product group with rigid verticals and small gaps

cases.subject: wind turbines along a ridge above farm fields
cases.composition: deep panoramic view with repeating towers receding into distance

styles.selection_rationale: A musician, diving bird, transparent bottle, and rainy street supply gesture, speed, overlap, reflection, and depth without embedding watercolor or wash cues in the source content.

cases.subject: violinist pausing between phrases
cases.composition: seated half-length portrait with bow angled across the frame

cases.subject: kingfisher diving toward water with wings tucked
cases.composition: small bird descending through a tall frame toward one ripple

cases.subject: clear medicine bottle, brass key, and folded blue ribbon
cases.composition: close tabletop still life with transparent overlaps and narrow negative spaces

cases.subject: rainy open-air market street with awnings and reflections
cases.composition: eye-level street view leading between stalls toward a bright distant opening

styles.selection_rationale: Workshop portraiture, a small armored animal, navigation objects, and an alpine route provide varied seams, scales, and surface divisions while ensuring the style is not tested only on textile-friendly subjects.

cases.subject: instrument repairer holding calipers beside a workbench
cases.composition: three-quarter standing portrait framed by two partially open instrument cases

cases.subject: stag beetle among oak leaves and two acorns
cases.composition: close overhead cluster with the beetle crossing a diagonal twig

cases.subject: enamel camping mug, compass, and folded map
cases.composition: overhead arrangement with the map creating an irregular ground shape

cases.subject: alpine footpath leading to a small stone shelter
cases.composition: wide view with the path entering low and bending toward the shelter
